text: PAY-341: a customer was charged twice after a dispute. The second charge came from a dispute webhook Stripe resent ~3 days later.
Stripe resends dispute events for up to 72 hours, not 24. Our idempotency key had already expired.
So the 24h TTL assumption was wrong for disputes. Did we ever write that decision down?
No, it only lived in this channel. I'll extend dispute keys to 7 days and add a ledger-level unique constraint as a backstop.
